notes: G-1 delivery of IMP-0257 evidence freshness. Live named probes exit 0. Recorded-council histogram: 4/8 stale at decision time. Cache-pointed revalidation FIRED at the transport layer. Did not run global unit_manifest.py --write. cloud ok is not consulted.
question: Implement tools/council/evidence/freshness.py stamping every evidence anchor with an as-of date and refusing to let a stale anchor carry a binding decision without revalidation. How many anchors in a recorded council are older than the configured freshness window, and does revalidation actually re-read the source rather than a cached copy of it?

residual_unknowns.claim: IMP-0310 (deadlock detector) and IMP-0305 (Bayesian pooling) are catalog dependencies and are not delivered on this worktree. freshness.py does not import them; wiring the gate into a live council kernel is those units' work.

reviewer.method: Fill cache, mutate disk, revalidate via cache (FIRED, old hash), revalidate via FileTransport (SILENT, new hash, admitted).
reviewer.obligation: Transport-layer check must FIRE when revalidation is pointed at the cache; cache.report is not proof of a source read.
